notes: MLS Assist v1.38 — Seamless Athena pop-up + connection-truth fix (built on the current canonical v1.37). A clean, draggable pop-up (collapses to a small stethoscope pill) now sits over athenaOne so the doctor never leaves Athena: Go reads the open patient + pulls their full visit history with live progress, Record captures the visit (segmented recorder via an offscreen document), Finish generates the note + suggested E/M/ICD-10/CPT, then writes the note back into the chart behind a name+DOB match gate — verified, and it NEVER clicks Save or Sign (the doctor signs). Read-only except the deliberate, gated note write. The codes-into-pickers driver ships OFF (needs one live athenaOne tuning pass) and lists codes for manual entry until enabled. Also fixes the phantom 'athenaOne tab open & readable' status: the schedule/report handlers no longer fall back to an unrelated most-recently-active tab and report it as connected — only a genuine athenaOne tab counts, and replies are stamped with a non-PHI emr/host marker the app verifies. All prior v1.37 features unchanged. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
